name: Magma Colossus
note: Same rig as the Frost Warden. Draw flipped (face left) when the hero enters from the left.

weakpoint.note: magma core in the chest; glows brighter when exposed (telegraph, hurt, attack wind-ups). Only take damage (or double damage) while it glows. Ice deals double damage.

attack_slam.notes: frame 2 = fists hit the ground: spawn fx_lava_wave

attack_rain.notes: roar on frames 1-3: molten rocks fall

death.notes: cools to grey; hold the last frame (rock pile)

attackPattern.name: Magma Slam
sequence: attack_slam frame 2 = impact: spawn fx_lava_wave at the front fist on the ground, travelling toward the hero at 150px/s
the wave hurts on contact; jump over it

spawnOffset.note: bottom of the wave at the fist, facing right

attackPattern.name: Molten Rain
sequence: attack_rain: on frame 1 show fx_warning_heat at 5 spots across the arena
0.7s later drop fx_falling_magma from the ceiling at each spot; on landing spawn hazard_falling_rock_shatter

phase2: below 50% HP: two waves in a row, 7 rocks, shorter telegraph (0.6s)
onDeath: death 8f, hold the last frame (grey rock pile); the family photo item appears on the pile
